question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in the brackets to fill in the blank.**

We live on the ________ (centre) of the city.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2' i.e. 'Outskirts'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Centre"** refers to the middle part or point of something. (केंद्र" or "मध्य)

 
 
• **Example: **They live in the centre of the city.
 
 
 
• The word** "Outskirts" i**s the opposite of 'centre'. It refers to the outer parts of a town or city. (नगर निगम क्षेत्र के बाहरी हिस्से).
 
 
• **Example**: They moved to the outskirts of the city to enjoy a quieter life.
 
 

**Therefore, the correct answer is - 'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, **"Interior" **means situated within or inside; relating to the inside; inner.(आंतरिक)
 
• Option 3,** "Middle"** refers to the point or part that is equally distant from the sides or the ends or the top and bottom; central.(बीच)
 
• Option 4, **"Downtown**" is a term primarily used in North America to refer to a city's commercial, cultural and often the historical, political and geographic heart, and is often synonymous with its central business district.(शहर का केंद्रीय क्षेत्र)
